name: Turn-of-Month Flow Window
note: Pure calendar: long from the close of the second-to-last weekday session of the month through the close of the third session of the new month, with no indicator condition. Optional skip when the previous session's ATR/close sits above the 90th percentile of its own trailing history. McConnell & Xu's four-day turn-of-month window.
source: John J. McConnell and Wei Xu, 'Equity Returns at the Turn of the Month', Financial Analysts Journal 64(2), 2008 - trading rules and magnitude VERIFIED via https://quantpedia.com/strategies/turn-of-the-month-in-equity-indexes/, which specifies 'Buy SPY ETF 1 day (some papers say 4 days) before the end of the month and sell the 3rd trading day of the new month at the close'. Mechanism: Ogden (1990) on standardised payment dates; Lakonishok and Smidt (1988) on calendar anomalies.
code:
def family_init(ctx):
    """No indicator input at all -- the window is read off the bar timestamps.
    T is the last weekday session of the calendar month; the position runs
    from the close of T-1 to the close of session `exit_day` of the new month."""
    import calendar
    import indicators as I
    bars = ctx.bars
    m = len(bars)

    def nth_dow(y, mo, dow, n):
        c = 0
        for d in range(1, calendar.monthrange(y, mo)[1] + 1):
            if calendar.weekday(y, mo, d) == dow:
                c += 1
                if c == n:
                    return d
        return 32

    dst = {}
    wds = {}

    def fields(t):
        y = int(t[0:4]); mo = int(t[5:7]); d = int(t[8:10])
        hh = int(t[11:13]); mi = int(t[14:16])
        k = (y, mo)
        if k not in dst:
            dst[k] = (nth_dow(y, 3, 6, 2), nth_dow(y, 11, 6, 1))
            wds[k] = [x for x in range(1, calendar.monthrange(y, mo)[1] + 1)
                      if calendar.weekday(y, mo, x) < 5]
        s0, e0 = dst[k]
        on = ((mo > 3 or (mo == 3 and d >= s0))
              and (mo < 11 or (mo == 11 and d < e0)))
        et = hh * 60 + mi + (-240 if on else -300)
        return y, mo, d, et, wds[k]

    # one bar per calendar date means daily bars: every bar IS a session close
    daily = len(set(b["t"][:10] for b in bars)) == m

    eo = max(0, int(ctx.p.entry_off))
    ed = max(1, int(ctx.p.exit_day))
    emin = int(ctx.p.entry_min)
    win = [False] * m
    for i in range(m):
        y, mo, d, et, wd = fields(bars[i]["t"])
        if calendar.weekday(y, mo, d) >= 5:
            continue
        if daily:
            et = 960
        left = 0
        for x in wd:
            if x > d:
                left += 1
        idx = len(wd) - left
        w = False
        if left < eo:
            w = True
        elif left == eo:
            w = et >= emin
        if not w and idx <= ed:
            w = (idx < ed) or (et <= 960)
        win[i] = w
    ctx.win = ctx.series(win, "tom_window")

    # optional skip: session-level ATR/close above its own trailing percentile
    at = I.compute("atr", bars, period=int(ctx.p.atr_n))["atr"]
    vn = max(20, int(ctx.p.vol_n))
    pct = float(ctx.p.vol_pct)
    gate = [True] * m
    hist = []
    last = None
    prev = None
    ok = True
    for i in range(m):
        dte = bars[i]["t"][:10]
        if dte != prev:
            if last is not None:
                hist.append(last)
                if len(hist) > vn:
                    del hist[0]
            if len(hist) >= 20:
                srt = sorted(hist)
                thr = srt[int(pct * (len(srt) - 1))]
                ok = hist[-1] <= thr
            else:
                ok = True
            prev = dte
        a = at[i]
        c0 = float(bars[i]["c"])
        if a is not None and c0 > 0.0:
            last = a / c0
        gate[i] = ok
    ctx.gate = ctx.series(gate, "vol_gate")


def signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.win[i]:
        return 0
    if ctx.p.vol_gate and not ctx.gate[i]:
        return 0
    return 1
